title: Verify native LeafOS TUI
objective: Build and verify the ncursesw LeafOS TUI, normalized snapshot parser, native bridge, and fail-closed control mailbox without modifying source files during this verification run.
constraints: Do not propose apply_patch or write_file steps.
Use only the exact declared test command.
Do not bypass the inlet for control actions.
acceptance: The native C renderer builds without compiler warnings.
The native parser consumes a normalized snapshot and rejects malformed JSON.
All seven pages remain reachable through the native input router.
Only named control actions can reach the inlet bridge.
The focused native and fallback TUI tests pass.
